newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Lawson Products raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Lawson Products raised.

text.p: - McDonald & Co said Friday it had raised its rating on Lawson Products Inc to hold from underweight.
- Analyst Rob Damron said he cut the stock to underweight in February and its recent price is down 11 percent.

- Damron said he lowered his 1996 earnings estimate to $1.65 a share from $1.70, versus $1.75 in 1995, after the company reported third quarter earnings Thursday of $0.42 a share, a penny below both his estimate and year-earlier earnings. Fourth quarter earnings are also expected to be lower than a year ago, he said.
- He said both upside and downside on the stock are limited.
